tools.name: check_expiry
tools.description: Expiry summary for up to 5 domains at once: served certificate expiry and issuer, undeployed newer certificate in CT logs, domain registration expiry (RDAP), and alert lines (Korean). Use this for inventories and periodic checks.

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: DNS and hosting facts for a domain: nameservers with DNS provider, A/AAAA with IP owner (ASN), CNAME, MX, CAA (which CAs may issue), SPF/DMARC, DNSSEC, registrar and domain expiry (RDAP).

tools.description: Explain a TLS/SSL certificate error message from a browser, curl/OpenSSL, Java, Python, Node.js, Go or .NET: likely causes, fixes, and links to step-by-step guides (Korean). Works offline from a curated knowledge base.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_dns · Private data: check_dns_propagation · Public sink: watch_expiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_dns · Private data: check_dns_propagation · Public sink: watch_expiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
